verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an npm SDK for runtime capture and prompt hooks, plus a note that 'you or your coding agent write the correction.' Neither establishes a documented management API that covers what the UI does: reviewing sessions, previewing routing matches, comparing holdout outcomes, or activating and rolling back corrections. All OpenAPI and Swagger probe paths returned 404, so there is no evidence of UI-to-API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
